tool_args.rationale: The pilot reaches s_grad = 2.44, just below the candidate onset range of 2.50–2.68. The avalanche term is zero throughout the pilot, so neither its onset nor its strength can be inferred from these rows. The high-gradient probe is the lowest-cost direct test of that branch.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a smooth two-layer siphon now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five gradients lie below the candidate threshold range, where the smooth and avalanche models make identical predictions.
Finer temporal sampling does not directly test whether crossing the sink-gradient threshold activates an additional loss.
